A '''safety''' was a device designed to prevent a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] from being accidentally discharged. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] modified all their [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] to include a safety.<ref name="NEGWT" />

The safety was located near the grip and trigger on [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] such as the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] and the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="EGWT" />
